title: 微生物为什么要运输，又该怎样运（国内版）
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/28_Why are microbes transported bacteriology microbiology raqbamicrohub.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/28_Why are microbes transported bacteriology microbiology raqbamicrohub（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 微生物运输，服务很多领域
points.K2: 科研：研究特性与相互作用
points.K3: 合作研究：共享与重复实验
points.K8: 生物技术：酶和生物燃料
points.S1: 三层包装：一层漏了还有两层
points.S3: 学生不私带、不邮寄、不交换菌株

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，身边放着一个带生物危害标志的运输箱
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab door beside a transport box with a biohazard warning sign and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天聊聊：微生物为什么要运输。
overlay: 微生物为什么要运输，又该怎样运

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁出现一条从实验室到各处的路线图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a route map with arrows from a lab icon to a hospital, a factory, a farm and a school.
shots.narration: 以及，怎样运才安全。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一支菌种管，对着手机聊天
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a sealed culture tube with a blank label and chats on his phone.
shots.narration: 外校同学想要阿杰实验室的一株菌。

shots.scene: 阿杰把菌种管往普通快递信封里塞
shots.prompt_en: The young male student starts to slip the tube into an ordinary padded mailing envelope.
shots.narration: 阿杰想：装个信封，寄过去就行。

shots.scene: 小研按住信封，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts her hand on the envelope and shakes her head.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：微生物可不能这样寄。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 先看看，微生物为什么要运来运去。

shots.section_title: 微生物运输，服务很多领域
shots.scene: 四个图标：显微镜、医疗十字、工厂、树叶
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a microscope, a medical cross, a factory and a leaf. No people.
shots.narration: 运输微生物，是很多领域的日常需要。
overlay: 微生物运输，服务很多领域

shots.section_title: 微生物运输，服务很多领域
shots.scene: 七个图标排成圆环
shots.prompt_en: Seven icons arranged in a ring: a microscope, a hospital, a factory, a globe, a freezer, a school and a check mark badge. No people.
shots.narration: 归纳起来，主要有七类用途。

shots.section_title: 科研：研究特性与相互作用
shots.scene: 小研在显微镜前观察，旁边培养皿
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks through a microscope with culture dishes beside her.
shots.narration: 第一类是科研。
overlay: 科研：研究特性与相互作用

shots.section_title: 科研：研究特性与相互作用
shots.scene: 微生物图标在不同环境：土壤、水、肠道图标间移动
shots.prompt_en: A microbe icon placed in different environments: soil, water and a gut outline icon. No people.
shots.narration: 研究微生物的特性、行为和相互作用。

shots.section_title: 科研：研究特性与相互作用
shots.scene: 实验室、高校、研究所三个楼图标用箭头连接
shots.prompt_en: Three building icons, a lab, a university and an institute, connected by arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 菌株在实验室和研究机构之间流转。

shots.section_title: 合作研究：共享与重复实验
shots.scene: 两个课题组桌子之间传递样本盒
shots.prompt_en: Two research group benches with a sealed sample box passed between them along an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 合作研究，要在课题组之间共享菌株。
overlay: 合作研究：共享与重复实验

shots.section_title: 合作研究：共享与重复实验
shots.scene: 两份相同的实验结果图打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two identical blank result charts side by side, each with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 别人重复实验，也需要同一株菌。

shots.scene: 药片、胶囊、酸奶瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pill, a capsule and a small probiotic drink bottle with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 开发新药、抗生素、益生菌等产品。

shots.scene: 研发楼图标，箭头从实验室指向它
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from a lab icon to a product development building icon. No people.
shots.narration: 菌株要送到研发单位。

shots.scene: 医院图标指向检验科，样本管在密封盒里
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from a hospital icon to a diagnostic lab icon, carrying a sealed box of sample tubes. No people.
shots.narration: 第二类是医疗：样本送去检验。

shots.scene: 检验人员图标在安全柜前分析，旁边放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A diagnostic lab icon with a biological safety cabinet and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 分析、鉴定，确认是什么感染。

shots.scene: 疫苗瓶图标和生产车间图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a vaccine vial with a blank label and a production facility. No people.
shots.narration: 研发和生产疫苗，也要运送毒株。

shots.scene: 运输箱进入有资质标志的大楼
shots.prompt_en: A sealed transport box entering a building with a certificate badge icon. No people.
shots.narration: 只能送到有资质的单位。

shots.scene: 通用病原图标送入高等级实验室门
shots.prompt_en: A generic microbe icon in a sealed box moving toward a high-level containment lab door with an approval stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 传染病研究，要送到专门的实验室。

shots.scene: 盾牌和药瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a shield and a medicine bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 研究治疗方法和预防措施。

shots.section_title: 生物技术：酶和生物燃料
shots.scene: 发酵罐图标，冒出酶和燃料滴图标
shots.prompt_en: A fermentation tank icon producing an enzyme icon and a fuel drop icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第三类是工业：生产酶和生物燃料。
overlay: 生物技术：酶和生物燃料

shots.section_title: 生物技术：酶和生物燃料
shots.scene: 菌种箱从实验室送往工厂
shots.prompt_en: A sealed culture box moves from a lab icon to a factory icon. No people.
shots.narration: 生产菌种要送到工厂。

shots.scene: 面包、酸奶、发酵饮品图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of bread, yogurt and a fermented drink bottle with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 面包、酸奶，都离不开发酵。

shots.scene: 酵母、乳酸菌、霉菌三个卡通微生物
shots.prompt_en: Three friendly cartoon microbes: a yeast cell, a rod-shaped bacterium and a mold strand. No people.
shots.narration: 酵母、乳酸菌、霉菌被送去生产线。

shots.scene: 农田里施撒微生物菌剂图标，作物长高
shots.prompt_en: A field icon where a microbial product is applied and crops grow taller. No people.
shots.narration: 农业上，有益微生物改良土壤。

shots.scene: 作物叶片上的害虫图标被盾牌挡住
shots.prompt_en: A pest icon blocked by a shield over crop leaves. No people.
shots.narration: 还能促生长、防病虫。

shots.scene: 受污染的土地和水面图标，微生物在分解污渍
shots.prompt_en: Icons of polluted soil and an oily water surface, with friendly microbes breaking down dark stains. No people.
shots.narration: 第四类是环境：生物修复。

shots.scene: 污渍逐渐消失，土地变绿
shots.prompt_en: The dark stains gradually fade and the land turns green. No people.
shots.narration: 微生物分解油污，固定重金属。

shots.scene: 污水处理池图标，水由浑变清
shots.prompt_en: A wastewater treatment tank icon where cloudy water turns clear. No people.
shots.narration: 污水处理厂，也要补充微生物。

shots.scene: 低温冰箱和一排排菌种管图标
shots.prompt_en: An ultra-low temperature freezer with racks of sealed tubes with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 第五类是保藏：菌种保藏中心。

shots.scene: 菌种管进出保藏中心的双向箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two-way arrows between a lab icon and a culture collection building icon. No people.
shots.narration: 菌株存进去长期保存，用时再取。

shots.scene: 森林、海洋、沙漠图标各连到一支样本管
shots.prompt_en: Forest, ocean and desert icons each linked to a sample tube. No people.
shots.narration: 从不同生态环境采集微生物。

shots.scene: 地球图标周围一圈多样的卡通微生物
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon surrounded by a ring of diverse friendly cartoon microbes. No people.
shots.narration: 研究微生物的多样性和作用。

shots.scene: 教室里的教学实验台，老周在讲台前
shots.prompt_en: The older man teaches at the front of a teaching lab with students at benches.
shots.narration: 第六类是教学。

shots.scene: 教学用菌种管放在带锁的冰箱里
shots.prompt_en: Teaching culture tubes with blank labels in a locked refrigerator. No people.
shots.narration: 教学菌株要送到学校和培训中心。

shots.scene: 会议展台和工作坊实验台图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a conference booth and a hands-on workshop bench. No people.
shots.narration: 工作坊和会议，也会用到菌株演示。

shots.scene: 食品、药品、化妆品三个图标，旁边放大镜
shots.prompt_en: Icons of food, a medicine bottle and a cosmetic jar, each with a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 第七类是质控。

shots.scene: 检测样本送往质控实验室，结果打勾
shots.prompt_en: A sealed sample box goes to a quality control lab icon, which returns a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 监测微生物污染，保证产品合格。

shots.scene: 盖章的证书图标和检测报告
shots.prompt_en: A blank certificate with a stamp icon next to a blank test report. No people.
shots.narration: 检测和认证，也要运送菌株样本。

shots.scene: 国家和国际两个徽章图标
shots.prompt_en: Two badge icons, one national and one international, with check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 为了符合国内外的法规要求。

shots.scene: 七个用途图标汇成一个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The seven use icons merge into one shield. No people.
shots.narration: 运输推动科研、医疗和环保。

shots.scene: 运输箱里有温度计图标和活菌图标
shots.prompt_en: A transport box with a thermometer icon and a lively microbe icon inside. No people.
shots.narration: 规范运输，既保活性，也保安全。

shots.scene: 国内第一类到第四类四格，第一类标红
shots.prompt_en: Four boxes stacked with the top box red and the bottom box green, arrows showing danger decreasing downward. No people.
shots.narration: 国内分类，第一类最危险。

shots.scene: 国际分组与国内分类两列，箭头方向相反
shots.prompt_en: Two columns of four boxes with arrows pointing in opposite directions. No people.
shots.narration: 和国际危险度分组方向正好相反。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白审批单上盖章，旁边卫生健康主管部门楼图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stamps a blank application form beside a government health office building icon.
shots.narration: 高致病性材料运输，要报主管部门批准。

shots.scene: 运输箱旁两名护送人员图标
shots.prompt_en: A sealed transport box accompanied by two escort person icons beside a dedicated vehicle. No people.
shots.narration: 专人护送，不搭公共交通。

shots.section_title: 三层包装：一层漏了还有两层
shots.scene: 三层包装分解图：管、袋、硬箱
shots.prompt_en: An exploded view of triple packaging: a sealed tube, a leak-proof bag with absorbent pad, and a rigid outer box. No people.
shots.narration: 运输生物材料，要用三层包装。
overlay: 三层包装：一层漏了还有两层

shots.section_title: 三层包装：一层漏了还有两层
shots.scene: 主容器拧紧，周围吸水材料
shots.prompt_en: A tightly capped tube wrapped in absorbent material. No people.
shots.narration: 第一层防漏，周围放吸收材料。

shots.section_title: 三层包装：一层漏了还有两层
shots.scene: 二级包装密封，外包装硬质
shots.prompt_en: The wrapped tube sealed in a leak-proof second bag, then placed in a rigid outer box. No people.
shots.narration: 第二层再密封，第三层坚固防撞。

shots.section_title: 三层包装：一层漏了还有两层
shots.scene: 外箱侧面放着空白清单
shots.prompt_en: A blank contents list tucked between the second bag and the outer box. No people.
shots.narration: 清单放在外层，开箱前就能核对。

shots.scene: 两个运输箱，分别贴不同的菱形标记
shots.prompt_en: Two transport boxes, each with a different diamond-shaped marking with pictograms only. No people.
shots.narration: 感染性物质分A类和B类。

shots.scene: A类箱上编号格亮起
shots.prompt_en: Number panels light up on the first box. No people.
shots.narration: A类危害高，编号2814或2900。

shots.scene: B类箱上编号格亮起
shots.prompt_en: A number panel lights up on the second box. No people.
shots.narration: B类一般诊断样本，编号3373。

shots.scene: 王老师对照空白规定文件
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks a blank regulation binder.
shots.narration: 具体包装和限量，以现行规定为准。

shots.section_title: 学生不私带、不邮寄、不交换菌株
shots.scene: 快递信封里的菌种管被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A culture tube in an ordinary mailing envelope, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 菌株不能用普通快递寄。
overlay: 学生不私带、不邮寄、不交换菌株

shots.section_title: 学生不私带、不邮寄、不交换菌株
shots.scene: 背包里的菌种管被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A culture tube in a backpack on a bus, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 也不能装进包里随身带走。

shots.section_title: 学生不私带、不邮寄、不交换菌株
shots.scene: 阿杰把需求告诉老周，老周拿出空白申请单
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tells the older man about the request; the older man takes out a blank application form.
shots.narration: 需要转移菌株，先告诉导师。

shots.section_title: 学生不私带、不邮寄、不交换菌株
shots.scene: 申请单经过登记、审批图标，交给专业运输
shots.prompt_en: The blank form passes a register icon and an approval stamp, then goes to a professional courier vehicle. No people.
shots.narration: 由单位登记审批，交有资质的单位运送。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在七个用途图标的圆环中间
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in the middle of the ring of seven use icons.
shots.narration: 科研医疗、工业环境、保藏教学和质控。

shots.scene: 三层包装和审批印章图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of triple packaging and an approval stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 高致病性要审批，国内第一类最危险。

shots.scene: A类、B类箱子和被打叉的快递信封
shots.prompt_en: Two transport boxes with different markings and a crossed-out mailing envelope. No people.
shots.narration: 三层包装，分清类别，不私寄。

shots.scene: 阿杰把信封收起，和老周一起填申请单
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts away the envelope and fills in a blank application form with the older man.
shots.narration: 阿杰决定：走正规渠道。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰在运输箱旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye beside a sealed transport box.
shots.narration: 运得对，才运得安全，下次见！
